_derived: tools/derive_pin_dependents.py — do not edit by hand
_method: every candidate artefact is hashed (sha256 and git blob sha1) and every hash literal in every gate is looked up in that table. A literal that matches a file IS a pin on it, whatever the surrounding comment claims.
_why: 8432492 re-pinned six sibling gates and missed the seventh; apexpool-verify then went red on that PR, merged, and stayed red for fifteen days. When a change re-pins, the dependents are derived, never counted.
